caught.content:
- name: Smoke the installed package
        run: |
          installed="$(npm root)/@neralabs/rerail"
          for hook in cursor claude codex; do
            test -f "$installed/dist/$hook-hook.js" || { echo "missing dist/$hook-hook.js" >&2; exit 1; }
          done

- name: Check the hooks
        run: test -f dist/hosts/cursor/cursor-hook.js

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths-ignore:
      - "**/*.md"
      - "docs/**"

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      # what the package ships
      - "src/**"
      - "native/**"
      - package.json

on:
  pull_request:
    paths: ["package.json", "src/**", "native/src/**"]

strategy:
      matrix:
        # One leg per gated tool-pack: a pack's upstream tool with packs/<pack>/upstream/<tool>/gates.yaml.
        include:
          - pack: python
            tool: ruff
          - pack: python
            tool: bandit

env:
          # recording a tool-pack is one run of the live adapter; plan.test.ts fails when the two lists differ.
          TOOL_PACKS: |
            [
              {"pack": "python", "tool": "ruff"},
              {"pack": "sql", "tool": "sqlfluff"}
            ]

matrix:
        include:
          - tool: ruff
            pack: python

matrix:
        pack: [python, sql, vue]

- name: Set up the pinned PHP and Composer
        if: matrix.pack == 'php' || matrix.pack == 'blade'
        uses: ./.github/actions/php

- name: Set up PHP
        run: |
          if [ "$PACK" = php ]; then ./scripts/php.sh; fi

runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - if: inputs.tool == 'clippy'
      run: rustup component add clippy
      shell: bash

- name: Smoke the hooks
        run: |
          hosts="$installed/dist/hosts"
          for host in claude codex cursor; do
            test -f "$hosts/$host/$host-hook.js" || { echo "missing $host hook" >&2; exit 1; }
          done

- name: Smoke the installed package
        run: |
          test -f "$installed/dist/harness/hook-launcher.js"
          test -f "$installed/dist/cli/daemon-entry.js"
          test -f "$installed/dist/harness/event-stream.js"

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "**"
      - "!docs/**"
      - "!**/*.md"

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: [
      "src/**",
      "native/**",
      "package.json",
    ]

strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: Python Ruff
            pack: python
            tool: ruff
          - name: SQLFluff
            pack: sql
            tool: sqlfluff

matrix:
        include:
          - tool: ruff
            version: 0.16.9
            pack: python

strategy:
      matrix:
        pack:
          - python
          - sql
          - vue

strategy:
      matrix:
        tool-pack: [python/ruff, sql/sqlfluff, vue/eslint-plugin-vue]

- name: Pull each tool-pack's data
        run: |
          for pack in python sql vue; do
            node scripts/s3/pack-fixtures.mjs pull --pack "$pack"
          done

- run: |
          while read -r pack tool; do
            if [ "$pack" = php ] || [ "$pack" = blade ]; then ./scripts/php.sh; fi
          done < legs.tsv

- env:
          PACK: ${{ matrix.pack }}
        run: |
          if [[ $PACK == php || $PACK == blade ]]; then ./scripts/php.sh; fi

- id: plan
        run: |
          echo "php=$(jq -c '[.[] | select(.pack == "php" or .pack == "blade")]' <<< "$TOOL_PACKS")" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

- name: Set up PHP
        if: matrix.leg.pack == 'php' || env.PACK == 'blade' || needs.plan.outputs.pack == 'php'
        uses: ./.github/actions/php

- name: Pack the complexity pack apart
        if: inputs.pack == 'complexity'
        run: npm pack --workspace packs/complexity

# The three tool-packs the Rust tests read, each its own cache key.
  test-data-legs:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - pack: python
            tool: ruff
          - pack: sql
            tool: sqlfluff
          - pack: vue
            tool: eslint-plugin-vue
    steps:
      - uses: ./.github/actions/pack-test-data
        with:
          pack: ${{ matrix.pack }}
          tool: ${{ matrix.tool }}
          fetch: "true"

passed.content:
- run: node dist/cli/cli.js install --root . --agents omp,pi,claude-code,codex,cursor --dry-run
      - run: |
          test -f "$installed/dist/engine/package-root.js"
          test -f "$installed/dist/ui/index.html"

- id: affected
        name: Does this push change what core ships, or the matrix?
        run: |
          if ! run="$(node scripts/host/azure/matrix.mjs affected --base "$BEFORE" --head "$AFTER")"; then exit 1; fi
  azure:
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.run == 'true'

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - Cargo.lock
      - Cargo.toml
      - native/Cargo.toml
      - .cargo/config.toml
      - rust-toolchain.toml

- uses: ./.github/actions/pack-test-data
        with:
          pack: python
          tool: ruff
          fetch: "true"

- if: inputs.pack != ''
        env:
          PACK: ${{ inputs.pack }}
        run: echo "$PACK"

description: 'The tool-packs to bump, as JSON: [{"pack": "<id>", "tool": "<tool>"}].'
        run: jq -c '[.[] | { pack: .[0], tool: .[1] }]'

# The hooks sit under dist/hosts/<host>/ in the package; the smoke below reads ENTRY_POINTS for them.
      - name: Smoke the installed package
        run: node scripts/smoke.mjs "$installed"

- uses: github/codeql-action/init@v4
        with:
          languages: javascript-typescript
          config: |
            paths-ignore:
              - test/**
              - fixtures/**

name: Engine fuzz
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "native/**"
      - "Cargo.lock"
      - "Cargo.toml"
      - "rust-toolchain.toml"

- uses: github/codeql-action/init@v4
        with:
          config: |
            paths:
              - src/**
              - native/**

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tool-packs:
        description: 'The tool-packs to bump, as JSON, for example [{"pack": "python", "tool": "ruff", "version": "0.16.9"}].'
        required: true
        type: string

- name: Plan every tool-pack
        if: inputs.pack == 'all'
        run: npm run upstream:releases -- --json "$RUNNER_TEMP/releases.json"
